result:
I ran all 14 queries against the input files and each gave a sensible answer. I didn't check the answers against an independent calculation. These are the answers I saw:

| Task | Answer |
|---|---|
| T1 | 4 |
| T2 | `["alice","carol","erin","ivan"]` |
| T3 | `{US: 3, DE: 2, unknown: 2, FR: 2}` |
| T4 | 33.17 |
| T5 | `["bug","feature","performance","tests","urgent"]` |
| T6 | `[{106, carol}, {102, null}, {108, null}]` |
| T7 | `{alice: 3, bob: 1}` |
| T8 | `["eslint@^8.56.0","express@^4.18.2","jest@^29.7.0","typescript@^5.3.3","zod@^3.22.0"]` |
| T9 | `"auth,reports,search"` |
| T10 | `{db: 3, api: 1, worker: 1}` |
| T11 | 330.2 |
| T12 | 204.91 |
| T13 | `[{Birch, 109.97}, {Acme, 104.96}]` |
| T14 | `"elderberry-banana-cherry-apple-date-kiwi-fig"` |

In T3, T7, T10 and T13 the map and customer keys print as keywords (`:db`, `:Acme`). The language allows only keyword keys in a map. For T13, I converted the customer back to a string.

T10 splits log lines on single spaces. T11 relies on the `ms=` tokens being the only ones that start with `ms=`. I didn't check either against odd spacing in `logs.txt`.

T1: 4
T1: /data/users | filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com") | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | any ~(lower | eq "admin")) | sort ~(/name | lower) * /name
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * count
T4: /data/users * (at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * /labels | flat * (/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * {:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)}
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) * count
T8: (unionOf /dependencies /devDependencies) | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | sort ~(/0) * (:v /1 | /0 | keyword | append "@" | append v)
T9: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | coalesce false) | filter ~(/port | gt 8000) * (/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) * count
T11: lines * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=")) | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (/0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | eq "shipped") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson)) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 * split "," | filter ~(/5 | lower | ne "cancelled") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") * {:c /1 :t (mulOf (/3 | parseJson) (/4 | parseJson))} | groupBy ~(/c) * (* /t | sum | round 2) | entries * {:customer (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~(/total | desc) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] * lower | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | join "-"
